definitions.explanation: A person, especially one of importance or distinction.
A character in a story, play, or film.

examples.japanese: {歴史|れきし}{上|じょう}の{重要|じゅうよう}な{人物|じんぶつ}について{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: I learned about important historical figures.

examples.japanese: この{小説|しょうせつ}の{主要|しゅよう}{人物|じんぶつ}は{三人|さんにん}いる。
examples.english: There are three main characters in this novel.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{立派|りっぱ}な{人物|じんぶつ}だ。
その{事件|じけん}の{中心|ちゅうしん}{人物|じんぶつ}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: The central figure in the incident was arrested.

examples.japanese: {明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}の{偉大|いだい}な{人物|じんぶつ}について{調|しら}べている。
examples.english: I'm researching great figures of the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ}の{性格|せいかく}が{細|こま}かく{描|えが}かれている。
examples.english: The characters' personalities are depicted in fine detail.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}の{人物|じんぶつ}はすべて{架空|かくう}のものです。
examples.english: All the characters in this film are fictional.

examples.japanese: {面接|めんせつ}では{能力|のうりょく}だけでなく{人物|じんぶつ}も{見|み}られている。
examples.english: In interviews, not only ability but also character is being assessed.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}は{人物|じんぶつ}{評価|ひょうか}を{重視|じゅうし}して{採用|さいよう}を{決|き}めている。
examples.english: The president makes hiring decisions with an emphasis on character evaluation.

notes:
{人物|じんぶつ} can refer to a real person, a fictional character, or someone's qualities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {登場|とうじょう}{人物|じんぶつ} (character in a story)
- {歴史|れきし}{人物|じんぶつ} (historical figure)
- {主要|しゅよう}{人物|じんぶつ} (main character/person)
- {人物|じんぶつ}{像|ぞう} (portrait, figure study)
- {人物|じんぶつ}{評価|ひょうか} (character evaluation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {人物|じんぶつ}: person of note, character (formal)
- {人|ひと}: person (basic, everyday)
- キャラクター: character (borrowed, often for fictional characters)
